item.text: {"question_id":"8B.4","answer":"The supplied evidence supports formal personnel authority and some institutional investment in capable implementers, but not a demonstrated record of Scholz personally selecting, empowering, retaining, replacing, or disciplining them. Under the Basic Law, he proposed ministerial appointments and dismissals and set policy guidelines, while ministers managed departments independently; this establishes authority and limits, not its exercise (BATCH-0035-E008). During 2023, BAMF maintained 1,267 trained special officers for vulnerable applicants, with defined consultation and takeover roles, and 8,447 positions overall with quality-management and monitoring arrangements (BATCH-0011-R03-E006; BATCH-0011-R01-E010). These arrangements indicate organizational provision for specialized personnel, but their effectiveness was mixed: reported cases showed trauma or torture indicators failing to trigger consultation, and BAMF did not record consultation or takeover rates (BATCH-0011-R03-E007). Other implementation evidence also shows capacity and staffing problems: overloaded local youth-welfare systems left some children in preliminary care for up to eight months, with guardians sometimes responsible for up to 50 minors and lacking sufficient capacity or expertise (BATCH-0011-R03-E009); independent asylum counselling was funded through a delayed and criticized process, with one centre offering two full-time counsellors for up to 600 applicants (BATCH-0011-R03-E011); and the Federal Court of Auditors found insufficient staffing in one ministry's support-programme administration, as well as unreviewed contracts and leadership selections at Autobahn GmbH that were not always publicly advertised and whose selection decisions were undocumented (BATCH-0003-E011; BATCH-0030-E007). Scholz explicitly rejected restoring conscription and preferred intensified use of reservists despite the Bundeswehr's approximately 181,000 personnel being below the 2027 target of 203,000, but the evidence does not establish whether that approach met staffing or readiness objectives (BATCH-0006-E006). The PUEG provides additional evidence of federal efforts to create staffing pools, support qualifications, attract care workers, and improve work-family conditions, although uptake and staffing effects in 2023 are not shown (BATCH-0033-E023). Overall, the record supports mixed institutional personnel capacity and some personnel-related policy design, but weak direct attribution for Scholz's personnel-management
